nodes.description: Owner address; initialized to 0x0, set to msg.sender in constructor; receives pump payout in gameResult().
uint32 rolling game counter incremented in startNewGame(); publicly readable.
uint256 accumulator of all received msg.value payments; updated in payable fallback.
bool lock flag controlling whether the fallback/join path is open; mutated by updateLock().
ContractParam pending/setter configuration (totalSize, singlePrice, pumpRate, hasChange).
ContractParam currently active configuration used for pricing and payouts.
Public dynamic array of participating player addresses; pushed in fallback, emptied in startNewGame.
Deploys contract, sets owner=msg.sender, initializes setConfig/curConfig and starts the first game.
onlyOwner function toggling isLock; calls stopGame() when locking and startNewGame() when unlocking.
onlyOwner private function that evenly refunds the contract balance to all players in a loop.
onlyOwner function reassigning the owner state variable to a new non-zero address.
onlyOwner payable function staging changes into setConfig and flagging curConfig.hasChange.
Private function that increments gameIndex, promotes setConfig into curConfig and clears addressArray.
Public view returning gameIndex, curConfig fields, addressArray, totalPrice and isLock.
Private function picking a pseudo-random winner from addressArray and distributing the balance to owner and winner.
Private view computing a pseudo-random array index from blockhash/now and player addresses.
Payable fallback used to join the game; validates origin, price and address code, then pushes sender into addressArray.
Private view using inline assembly extcodesize to reject contract callers.
Access-control modifier requiring msg.sender == owner.
Modifier requiring isLock == false before allowing the fallback join path.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, contract-code checks and player registration.
Block timestamp (now) used as randomness entropy in getRamdon and emitted in gameOverEvent.
Transaction origin compared against msg.sender in the payable fallback (anti-contract guard).
curPlayer.transfer(price) executed inside a loop over addressArray; state cleared only after all transfers.
owner.transfer(giveToOwn) external value transfer using owner-derived payout.
lastAddress.transfer(giveToActor) external value transfer to the pseudo-randomly selected winner.
totalPrice = totalPrice + msg.value unchecked uint256 addition (overflow risk).
uint giveToOwn = totalBalace * curConfig.pumpRate / 100; unchecked multiplication and division.
addressArray[index] direct index read derived from weak randomness; can revert or be manipulated.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(...now, blockhash...)) pseudo-randomness generation, predictable by miners.
Inline assembly extcodesize(addr) used to detect whether an address is a contract.
Constructor input uint32 _totalSize setting the target participant count.
Constructor input uint256 _singlePrice (in finney) setting the entry price.
updateLock input bool b; new desired lock status.
transferOwnership input address newOwner.
changeConfig input uint32 _totalSize staged into setConfig.
changeConfig input uint256 _singlePrice (in finney, multiplied by 1 finney).
changeConfig input uint8 _pumpRate owner payout percentage.
Local uint totalBalace = address(this).balance inside stopGame.
Local uint price = totalBalace / addressArray.length inside stopGame.
Loop counter i in stopGame.
Local address curPlayer = addressArray[i] inside stopGame.
Local uint index returned by getRamdon() inside gameResult.
Local address lastAddress = addressArray[index] inside gameResult.
Local uint giveToOwn = totalBalace * pumpRate / 100 inside gameResult.
Local uint giveToActor = totalBalace - giveToOwn inside gameResult.
Local bytes32 ramdon seed accumulated in getRamdon.
Loop counter i in getRamdon.
Local uint size populated from extcodesize in isNotContract.

edges.reason: constructor assigns the privileged owner state variable directly from the untrusted msg.sender.
constructor invokes startNewGame() to initialize the first round.
constructor writes the initial ContractParam into setConfig.
constructor writes the initial ContractParam into curConfig.
constructor consumes the _totalSize parameter.
constructor consumes the _singlePrice parameter.
notLock modifier gates entry to the payable fallback.
fallback reads the untrusted msg.sender for validation and registration.
fallback requires msg.sender == tx.origin as an anti-contract guard.
fallback calls isNotContract(msg.sender) to reject contract callers.
fallback reads curConfig.singlePrice and curConfig.totalSize for validation and win threshold.
fallback executes totalPrice = totalPrice + msg.value with unchecked uint256 addition.
fallback pushes msg.sender into addressArray.
fallback triggers gameResult() which performs external ETH transfers before state is reset.
fallback calls startNewGame() after gameResult() completes.
updateLock is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
updateLock writes the isLock state variable.
updateLock calls stopGame() which performs a loop of external ETH transfers.
updateLock calls startNewGame() when unlocking.
updateLock consumes the bool b parameter.
stopGame reads addressArray.length and each addressArray[i].
stopGame performs curPlayer.transfer(price) inside an unbounded loop over untrusted player addresses.
stopGame computes totalBalace from address(this).balance.
stopGame computes per-player price by dividing the balance by array length.
gameResult calls getRamdon() to select the winner index.
gameResult reads addressArray[index] for the winner.
gameResult indexes addressArray with a weakly random index value.
gameResult computes totalBalace * curConfig.pumpRate / 100 with unchecked arithmetic.
gameResult performs owner.transfer(giveToOwn), an external value call.
gameResult performs lastAddress.transfer(giveToActor) to the pseudo-random winner.
gameResult emits now (block.timestamp) in gameOverEvent, making the outcome timestamp-observable.
getRamdon seeds its pseudo-randomness with now and blockhash, i.e. block.timestamp dependency.
getRamdon iterates over addressArray and uses its length.
getRamdon builds its seed via keccak256(abi.encodePacked(..., now, ...)), a predictable randomness source.
getRamdon computes uint(ramdon) % addressArray.length and returns the index; reverts on empty array (divide by zero).
changeConfig is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
changeConfig sets curConfig.hasChange = true.
changeConfig writes totalSize, pumpRate and singlePrice into setConfig.
changeConfig consumes the _totalSize parameter.
changeConfig consumes the _singlePrice parameter and multiplies it by 1 finney.
changeConfig consumes the _pumpRate parameter.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership reassigns the privileged owner state variable.
transferOwnership consumes the newOwner parameter.
startNewGame performs gameIndex++ on a uint32 counter (unchecked increment/overflow).
startNewGame promotes setConfig values into curConfig.
startNewGame reads setConfig fields for comparison.
startNewGame resets addressArray.length to 0.
getGameInfo returns gameIndex.
getGameInfo returns curConfig fields.
getGameInfo returns addressArray.
getGameInfo returns totalPrice.
getGameInfo returns isLock.
isNotContract uses inline assembly extcodesize on the supplied address.
isNotContract stores the extcodesize result in the local size variable.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
notLock requires isLock == false before executing the guarded function body.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor-only input controlling the initial round size; folds into the constructor node.
Constructor-only input controlling the initial entry price; folds into the constructor node.
Single boolean argument written straight into isLock by updateLock.
Argument assigned directly to the owner state variable by transferOwnership.
Argument copied into setConfig.totalSize by changeConfig.
Argument scaled by 1 finney and copied into setConfig.singlePrice by changeConfig.
Argument copied into setConfig.pumpRate by changeConfig.
Temporary snapshot of address(this).balance inside stopGame.
Per-player amount computed for the looped transfer call inside stopGame.
Loop index used only inside stopGame.
Recipient address of the looped transfer call inside stopGame.
Temporary holder for getRamdon()'s return value inside gameResult.
Recipient of the winner payout transfer inside gameResult.
Amount passed to the owner transfer inside gameResult.
Amount passed to the winner transfer inside gameResult.
Accumulator of the keccak256 pseudo-random seed inside getRamdon.
Loop index used only inside getRamdon.
Result of the inline assembly extcodesize call inside isNotContract.
